原本有些疲惫的身体微微一晃，无言便重新变得神采奕奕了起来，这熟悉的感觉，每次都让无言留恋不已，不只是因为升级时实力的提升，同时，也是因为这会让身体产生异常舒服的快感，每次升级，都是一次享受啊…
将倒在身边的一头三阶魔兽身上的肉割下来一块之后，无言一挥手将其上缴给系统，得到一些道具点和能力点，无言就随地坐了下来，将手中的肉窜起，生火开烤。
虽然没有什么调味料在身上，但是无言却是烤得非常的认真，有‘厨艺精通’这项能力，就算只是单纯的烤肉，也会变得十分的美味。
人物：无言
能力：‘剑道精通’、‘厨艺精通’
装备：草薙剑（D级）
召唤人物：无
装备点：40000
道具点：250000
能力点：70000
召唤点：70000
等级：28
时隔两个月，这些，就是无言全部的收获了！
这两个月来，无言不断的在佣兵工会和巨兽森林之间来回跑，不断的做任务，杀魔兽，按理说，早就应该腻了，可是，无言硬是撑了过来。
虽然不想承认，但是无言知道，自己还很弱，自从来到这个世界，无言见到的人就没有一个等级比自己低的，虽然就别人的解释是那些实力低的人都不敢跑到巨兽森林里来，但是无言不想把这当借口。
就连一只万恶的，只能拿来当新手怪物刷经验的史莱姆，都比当初的自己等级要高，这让无言怎么能不受到打击呢，不去算当时自己才来到这个世界一个月，那只史莱姆，可是比自己大不了多少…
还有露露，17岁的天才少女，少了天才两个字，她也只是一个少女，但是，她都有35级了，可是一名四阶魔法师来着！
还有那些护卫大叔，每一个都是三阶，比当时的自己，也要强大不少啊…
就算是史莱姆带来的垃圾骑兵队，每一个都有二阶的实力，当时的自己，也才18级，二阶啊…

洛莉家族身为这个世界最顶尖的势力，三大帝国之一的艾路帝国第一家族，肯定不会只有这么一只骑兵队和护卫队吧，那就证明了，比自己强的人多了去了。
而且，有第一家族，就有第二家族，第三家族，他们就算比洛莉家族要弱，但是也应该不会差到哪里去吧？毕竟是一个大帝国里的大家族呢。
更何况，这还只是一个帝国，另外两个帝国，也有属于它们的第一家族，第二家族。
最最重要的是，菲菲，这个已经被无言问出了岁数的女子，她，才24岁！
比无言大上三四岁，人家已经是七阶强者了，就算在整个世界，也是站得起门面的人。
这所有的所有，都在残酷的告诉无言，自己，真的很弱！
虽然没有什么称霸世界的伟大志向，在没有穿越之前，无言只不过是一个普通的家里蹲而已，能够有什么野心吗？但是无言也不是甘心屈于人下的人，无言很清楚，在这样的一个世界里，实力，才是一切！
没有实力，在这个遍地超人的世界，自己要么当一个普通的人，普普通通的过一辈子，然后为了不得罪一些一只手都能捏死自己的战士和魔法师，每天心惊胆战的躲着、防着那些强者，‘规规矩矩’的过活，将自己的生死，寄托在别人的身上，然后死了，也不会有人在意一个普通人。
要么，就是为了掌握自己的命运，变强！
变得比谁都强！
这个世界上，肯定不只是有那么一只史莱姆，下一次因为一点小事就想砍自己的人，谁知道是什么阶别的，四阶？五阶？六阶？自己能够靠着露露和菲菲躲过一劫，但是，或者直到有一天，出现一个连菲菲都不得不妥协的强者，那个时候，自己只能任人宰割了。
别的不说，单单说露露吧，身为大家族的独生女，自己如果想要跟她继续做朋友，就必须得提升实力，大家族的人都是十分现实的，或许露露不在意，但是她家里的人，肯定不会希望她跟一个弱者来往，他们只会将人价值化，然后来进行取舍。
还有菲菲，她是一个七阶的强者，虽然看起来很温柔，但是无言知道，要不是有露露这条线，自己可能连跟菲菲答上一句话的资格都没有。
不是菲菲有多么现实，而是在这个实力至上的世界里，这样的情况，只不过是普遍的现象而已，你会跟你身边不经意爬过的蚂蚁聊天吗？谁会的，请告诉我一声…

The body that had been a little tired swayed slightly, and Wu Yan became energetic again. This familiar feeling makes Wu Yan linger on every time, not only because of the improvement in strength when upgrading, but also because it will make the body feel extremely comfortable. Every time he upgrades, it is an enjoyment...
After cutting off a piece of meat from a third-level monster lying next to him, Wu Yan handed it over to the system with a wave of his hand. After getting some prop points and ability points, Wu Yan sat down anywhere, picked up the meat in his hand, lit a fire and started roasting it.
Although there are no seasonings on him, Wu Yan is very serious about grilling. With the ability of 'cooking proficiency', even simple grilled meat will become very delicious.
Character: Silent
Abilities: ‘Proficient in Kendo’, ‘Proficient in Cooking’
Equipment: Kusanagi Sword (D level)
Summon characters: none
Equipment points: 40000
Item points: 250000
Ability points: 70000
Summoning points: 70000
Level: 28
After two months, these are all Wuyan’s gains!
In the past two months, Wu Yan has been running back and forth between the Mercenary Union and the Giant Beast Forest, constantly completing tasks and killing monsters. Logically speaking, he should have been tired of it long ago, but Wu Yan managed to hold on.
Although he doesn't want to admit it, Wu Yan knows that he is still very weak. Since he came to this world, no one he has seen is of a lower level than himself. Although others explain that those with lower strength dare not come to the giant beast forest, Wu Yan doesn't want to use this as an excuse.
Even an evil slime that could only be used as a novice monster to gain experience was higher than his original level. How could Wu Yan not be hit? Not counting that he had only been in this world for a month, that slime was not much older than himself...
There is also Lulu, a 17-year-old genius girl. Without the word genius, she is just a girl. However, she is already level 35, but she is a fourth-level magician!
There are also those guard uncles, each of them is at the third level, and they are much stronger than me at the time...
Even the garbage cavalry team brought by Slime, each one has the strength of the second level. At that time, I was only level 18, second level...
The Loli family, as the top power in the world and the first family of the Ailu Empire, one of the three major empires, would definitely not have only such a cavalry and escort team, which proves that there are many people stronger than themselves.
Moreover, there is a first family, a second family, and a third family. Even if they are weaker than the Luoli family, they shouldn't be much worse, right? After all, it is a big family in a big empire.
What's more, this is just one empire, and the other two empires also have their first and second families.
The most important thing is that Feifei, this woman who has been asked her age in silence, is only 24 years old!
Three or four years older than Wu Yan, he is already a seventh-level powerhouse. Even in the whole world, he is a person who can stand up to his reputation.
All of this cruelly told Wu Yan that he was really weak!
Although he does not have any great ambitions to dominate the world, before time travel, Wuyan was just an ordinary squatter at home. How could he have any ambitions? But Wu Yan is not someone who is willing to submit to others. Wu Yan knows very well that in such a world, strength is everything!
Without strength, in this world full of supermen, I can either be an ordinary person and live a normal life, and then in order not to offend some warriors and magicians who can crush me to death with one hand, I hide and guard against them every day in fear.Some strong people live a "proper" life, trusting their own life and death on others, and then when they die, no one will care about an ordinary person.
Or, just to control your own destiny and become stronger!
Become stronger than anyone else!
There must be more than just one slime in this world. The next time someone wants to kill him for a trivial matter, who knows what level he will be at, level four? Fifth level? Sixth level? He was able to escape the disaster by relying on Lulu and Feifei, but, perhaps until one day, a strong man appeared who even Feifei had to compromise. At that time, he could only let others slaughter him.
Let's not talk about anything else, let's just talk about Lulu. As the only daughter of a big family, if she wants to continue to be friends with her, she must improve her strength. People in the big family are very realistic. Maybe Lulu doesn't care, but the people in her family definitely don't want her to associate with a weak person. They will only value people and then make choices.
There is also Feifei, she is a seventh-level strong person. Although she looks very gentle, Wu Yan knows that if it were not for Lulu, he might not even be qualified to answer a sentence with Feifei.
It’s not that Feifei is so realistic, but in this world where strength is paramount, this situation is just a common phenomenon. Would you chat with the ants that crawled by you casually? Who knows, please tell me...
